product_overview: EPANET Solver is a single-page Streamlit web app for uploading EPANET network files and running hydraulic analysis workflows. It helps users inspect network data, analyze pressures, and iterate pipe sizing with solver tools.
core_goals: Upload an EPANET .inp network file into the app
Inspect network overview data for nodes and links
Analyze pressure-related results from the uploaded network
Run solver workflows to iterate pipe diameters using auto-solver tools
Use the Hardy Cross workflow to evaluate hydraulic behavior

features.name: Landing Page Navigation
features.description: The user can view the app landing content and move into the solver workflow from the start screen.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View landing page content -> Click "Get Started" to proceed to solver view
Navigate to / -> View landing page content -> Click "View Documentation" to open documentation content

features.name: Network Upload
features.description: The user can upload an EPANET input file to load a network into the application.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Upload an INP file using the file uploader dropzone -> View success message and file details

features.name: Hydraulic Analysis
features.description: The user can review network results and run hydraulic analysis tools from the tabbed solver interface.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Upload an INP file using the file uploader dropzone -> Navigate through the available tabs -> View node and link statistics in data tables -> View pressure analysis results
Navigate to / -> Upload an INP file using the file uploader dropzone -> Navigate through the available tabs -> Run auto-solver to iterate pipe diameters -> View updated solver results
Navigate to / -> Upload an INP file using the file uploader dropzone -> Navigate through the available tabs -> Use the Hardy Cross workflow -> View hydraulic analysis results
